Privacy Policy

Level Lens is designed to respect your privacy.

  • Level Lens does not collect, sell, or share your personal data.
  • Your browsing history, personal information, and salary searches are not stored or transmitted by us.
  • Any extension preferences stay on your device and can be deleted at any time by removing the app or extension.
  • Level Lens may request salary data directly from Levels.fyi to show results, but we do not proxy, store, or track those lookups.
  • Level Lens does not show third-party ads.

I don't want your data. Just a better job search.
